title: Original WAV signature guard and raw header fields

Native DataView wrong-brand/range failures are expected by error name only; no exact engine message is claimed.

trials.recognizedGateAssignmentScope: The complete supported-static import-free inventory recognizes zero gate descriptors; a single empty-gate context covers the sole modeled assignment, not all input/JavaScript/format/native-environment behavior.

fieldGrid.scope: All16selectedchannels×16selectedrates at length44 only. This does not claim the joint product with the separate larger-length samples, or full uint16×uint32 output/input domains.

shortLengths.scope: validateWav constructs DataView before testing byteLength44, then returns null for these short ArrayBuffers. parseWav does not validate signatures/minimum44: lengths0..27 throw native RangeError; selected lengths28..43 return raw fields even with an invalid signature.

largerLengths.scope: Ten selected lengths at this one field pair only; RIFF-size/data-length metadata are not updated to assert complete file consistency.

singleBitMutations.scope: One bit at a time in a fixed header. Magic mutations reject validation while raw parse still reads fields. Other mutations keep the two signatures and selected channels/rate bits change expected little-endian values. Multiple-bit/general-file domains remain unclosed.

trials.fixtureValidityScope: Synthetic signature-bearing scaffolding uses byteRate0/blockAlign0 and fixed RIFF-size36/data-length0. Values such as channels0 or65535 are deliberately not claims of valid PCM/audio. Positive validateWav results characterize its narrow actual length/signature predicate, not full RIFF/WAV validity.
trials.nativeErrorScope: Ten selected wrong-brand values for each export expect native TypeError, then a same-export literal baseline retry. Selected short raw buffers expect RangeError then same-export parse retry. Names only are specified where messages are unproved; invalid framework fixtures/infrastructure errors cannot satisfy source failures.
trials.returnedIdentityScope: Retain an actual signature-accepted ArrayBuffer with an independent byte expectation, feed that genuine return back to validateWav and compare identity true, then parse the retained buffer against independent literal fields. This is natural source-return composition, not argument-retention, backing ownership or mutation-isolation proof.
trials.sourcePredicate: validateWav tests only ArrayBuffer byteLength>=44 and big-endian RIFF/WAVE constants at0/8, after DataView construction. parseWav directly reads little-endian uint16@22 and uint32@24 and never calls validateWav.
trials.fixtures: Only ordinary JSON and realm ArrayBuffer/typed data fixtures. No stubs, gate fixtures, Babel/bootstrap helpers, clock/pending/callback/host-object/provider/native-audio authority is selected.
